test.name: Spec 0010 spike: kern.bootsessionuuid as boot ID

expected: sysctlbyname("kern.bootsessionuuid") returns one UUID for the current boot, the same from every process and on every read (spec 0010 AC-9, Adapter macOS row Boot)
actual: sysctlbyname returned 5E52ED28-4032-431E-9E64-B599BA083C49 (uppercase hex; spec 0010 stores it lowercase, 5e52ed28-4032-431e-9e64-b599ba083c49), stable across reads, equal to `sysctl -n kern.bootsessionuuid`, readable while a child is suspended, and equal to the value the old daemon process recorded. kern.boottime is 2026-10-12 12:13:01. A new value after a reboot is a separate BLOCKED record.
